content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates without relying on traditional payment platforms is essential for digital creators in regions where such services are unavailable or charge excessive fees. By utilizing an infrastructure that processes cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments, you can bypass the restrictions of platforms like Gumroad, which takes as much as 10% from each sale. This transition isn't just about accepting crypto; it's about gaining sovereignty over your commerce, allowing you to keep more of your earnings while delivering products directly to your customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling your Notion templates revolves around a combination of free and accessible tools. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, coupled with backend logic from Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you create a seamless experience for product delivery. Order storage can be managed with Supabase or Google Sheets, while NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions in real-time, ensuring that you receive payments swiftly and securely. This setup means that you own everything once deployed, eliminating dependencies on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, where traditional payment platforms are either restricted or excessively costly. If you are someone who sells digital products such as Notion templates, ebooks, or courses, and you want to maximize your earnings without losing a significant portion to platform fees, this is the solution for you. It empowers creators to operate independently and profitably, ensuring that you retain full ownership and control over your business.
Retain 99.5% of your revenue with NOWPayments instead of paying 10% to Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your digital store involves several key components. Firstly, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides an accessible platform for your products. Next, you need backend processing, achieved via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to manage orders and automate responses. Supabase or Google Sheets will serve as your database for order storage, while NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to operate effectively in a decentralized environment. Together, these elements create a streamlined and efficient commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, begin by selecting your hosting platform—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle logic and automation. Set up your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets and integrate NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Lastly, populate your store with your Notion templates and promote them directly to your audience. By following these steps, you can have your digital store up and running in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This method allows you to collect payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you keep a larger percentage of your sales without incurring high fees from traditional platforms. With NOWPayments, you only pay 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective solution for your digital sales.
Complete ownership of your digital store means no more platform dependencies.

If you're interested in selling Notion templates or any digital products without the restrictions of platforms like Gumroad, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all the blueprints and templates you need to establish your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own website and implementing a payment system that accepts cryptocurrencies. This approach eliminates the need for platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, giving you full control.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for crypto transactions?

NOWPayments offers several benefits, including low transaction fees of 0.5%, no KYC requirements, and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators looking to monetize their products.
